svg.title: Conservation ranger — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as conservation ranger, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Two distinct field-binocular lenses and short barrels sit above a separate veined conservation leaf. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
